rationale: After reaching a 1.69% maximum favorable excursion ($48.17), BSY has failed to sustain its breakout and surrendered nearly all gains, falling back below the 5-minute 9-EMA ($47.55) to $47.43. Meanwhile, broad market selling has intensified (SPY down -2.49% from -1.83% at entry, VIXY +17.11%), increasing the risk of a full breakdown toward session VWAP ($47.14). Closing at market protects capital against a round-trip loss while avoiding a short entry into a high relative-volume gainer still holding above VWAP.
